notes.title: Bronana Spring Promotion Version Update Announcement on March 10
notes.content:
Dear Players,

The Steam Spring Sale is just around the corner! To show our appreciation for your support and love, we've decided to add even more exciting content to this Spring Sale and release an early version update.

Here's a summary of what's new in this update:

1. New Character: **Drunken Fist Banana** and corresponding character-specific accessories.  

2. Regular Weapons:  
   - Thorn Whip  
   - Electric Guitar
  
3. Dark Gold Weapons:  
   - Man-eating Magic Staff  

4. Dark Gold Accessories:  
   - Lucky Slot Machine  
   - Grim Reaper's Scythe  
   - Hundred Thousand Volts  

We hope you enjoy the new content and have a fantastic time playing! Also, we look forward to the Steam Spring Sale from March 13th to March 20th, where we've prepared generous discounts for everyone.

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you have a great time with the new updates!

notes.title: Bronana New Year Version is Now Live! Discounts Will Start on January 26th!
notes.content:
Yo, dear players!

As the Spring Festival approaches, we have successfully launched the Endless Mode and updated five new characters and two new bosses! To give back to our beloved fans, we have decided to release this major New Year update ahead of the Spring Festival.

Here is a summary of the updates:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328248/a5e62d82e7ec677f1f08d1b8b52f59466f7d0f23.jpg

New Content:
1、Endless Mode: When you reach level 19, you can choose to enter the Endless Challenge through a door.

2、Two New Bosses:

Screw jeans and Claw nuts Boss
Hot dog Jason Boss

3、Five New Hero Characters: Each character comes with exclusive accessory items

Queen
Merchant
Alien
DJ
Cthulhu


Optimizations:
1、Added an option for special effect transparency.
2、Added an option to hide damage numbers.
3、Improved English line breaks to be more natural and reader-friendly.
4、Optimized the main interface and store page for easier reading when there is a lot of text.
5、Refreshing the store after buying out items no longer costs money.
6、Improved the readability of attribute icons.
7、Optimized the speed of entering the game when loading a save file.
8、If the roulette lands on an upgrade event but there are no upgradable items, the money will be refunded.
9、Expanded the area where the door appears with an explanatory prompt.
10、Added sticker explanations to the character selection interface.


Bug Fixes:
The issue of the demon deducting attributes multiple times when clicked multiple times has been fixed.

Of course, due to the tight schedule for producing a large amount of new content, we still discovered a significant optimization issue during testing【the game may experience slight frame drops and stuttering after reaching level 60 in Endless Mode (approximately two hours of continuous gameplay). 】Since this is a technical challenge, it will take more time to optimize and fix. However, we will work overtime to complete the fix as quickly as possible. To ensure you can enjoy the game during the Spring Festival, we have decided to launch the Endless Mode on schedule. We hope this will not significantly affect your gaming experience.

We hope you can understand and maintain a more objective attitude when evaluating our game. Your positive feedback and support are the biggest motivation for our development studio!

Finally, we wish you a happy New Year! Look forward to the New Year Sale on Steam from January 26th to February 9th. We have prepared generous discounts for everyone. Thank you again, and may you have a prosperous Year of the Snake!

notes.title: "Bronana" Patch update (12.30)
notes.content:
Dear player

In response to the anticipation and recognition from our vast community of gamers, we have updated some character bug feedback and gameplay optimization content today, aiming to provide a more enjoyable and relaxed gaming experience for our players!

We welcome all game enthusiasts to check it out!

Optimization Content:

1、Save system: We have added backup save functionality to enhance the robustness of the save system.
2、Weapon target priority: Players can now select their preferences in the settings.

Bug Fixes:

1、Resolved the issue with the transportation terminal where the iron ball disappears, preventing the continuation of the boss fight.
2、For continuous weapons, we have addressed the attack frequency issue after increasing the attack speed (e.g., brass knuckles).
3、Resolved the issue with the leader's pet selecting targets.
4、DJ Mole: Optimized attack animations to delay bullet firing after emerging from the ground.

We will continue to listen to the voices of our players and respond swiftly, constantly testing and optimizing the game to improve the player experience.

Finally, we sincerely thank all players for their enthusiastic feedback! We are honored and will continue to live up to expectations, providing support and services that players love!

notes.title: "Bronana" Patch update (12.24)
notes.content:
Dear players,

As mentioned in our previous thank-you letter, we have been actively working on game updates and optimizations, maintaining a high frequency of updates to bring "Banana Brothers" to you in a better form. Here is the announcement of the updates released today!

Bug Fixes:

1、Fixed the issue where rewards could be claimed multiple times after level settlement.
2、Re-adjusted the hit and damage range of the boss.
3、Fixed the issue where monster bullets would be destroyed after flying out of the screen.
4、Fixed the non-effective stacking effect of "Raven Collector."
5、Modified the "Lady's Lipstick" effect, which could not be stacked effectively.
6、Fixed the issue where equipment dropped into the Demonic Altar after level completion and could not be picked up when the backpack was full.
7、Fixed the bug where the "Bounty hunter" bounty effect did not disappear.
8、Fixed the bug where the bounty effect did not take effect after failing and retrying the challenge.
9、Fixed the non-effective stacking effect of "Lady's Gold Tooth."

New Content:

Before entering the level, two options have been added:
1、You can choose different NPCs with various feelings.
2、You can select bosses with different behavioral mechanisms.
3、Two new accessories have been added, a blue quality and a purple quality, both of which can increase the number of enemies.

Optimizations:

1、Adjusted the base damage of most melee weapons, which has been significantly increased.
2、For bounty tasks that require no damage, self-inflicted damage will not be counted in the damage data.
3、Modified the dash time of High Difficulty Canned beef.
4、Optimized and adjusted the value of the Scout, changing the -15 movement speed to a -30% movement speed bonus.
5、The probability of the Blacksmith replacing items incorrectly in high-level levels has been reduced.
6、For the sake of mobile user experience, the maximum effective speed has been set to 150%.

We hope these updates and optimizations will enhance your gaming experience. Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: "Bronana" Patch update
notes.content:
Dear Gameplayers,

Greetings!

In response to the anticipation and recognition from our vast player base, the update plan we released yesterday has been successfully completed today! We invite all players to come and check it out!

Next, we will initiate the next phase of updates and provide a detailed introduction to the upcoming updates we are about to release!

BUG Issues:

1、Fixed the issue where some characters might not have full health upon entering the game.
2、When redone outside the game, talent points will be returned at a rate of four times the original amount. 
3、Resolved the issue of too many babies following players.


Monster Numerical Adjustments:

1、Slightly adjusted the charging speed of the Canned beef.
2、Removed the invincible lock on health for bosses and adjusted the health of bosses accordingly.
3、Changed the "Grilled squid's binding" behavior to "releasing bullets in 8 directions with squid tentacles."
4、Adjusted the difficulty levels 1 and 2, weakening the damage and health of monsters in these levels.


Experience Issues:

1、Added a "retry option" in the settings.
2、Slightly adjusted weapon values to enhance some weapons.
3、Adjusted the weight of BD construction, making it easier to form a single series.
4、Removed the "range" description for weapons that should not have it.
5、lightly adjusted the probability of "good results" appearing in "blacksmith" and "roulette."
6、Reduced the maximum health deduction by the devil.

We are still working hard, and other updates will be completed as soon as possible. We are committed to making the player experience more enjoyable and satisfying, and we hope that the completed updates will bring you joy and satisfaction. At the same time, we will continue to update and optimize the content and playability of the game.

We will continue to listen to the voices of our players, respond quickly, and continuously test and optimize the game to improve the player experience.

Finally, we sincerely thank all players for their enthusiastic feedback! We are honored and will continue to provide support and services that players love!

notes.title: "Bronana" Patch update and future plan
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We have received your feedback regarding your gameplay experience, and we deeply apologize for the issues you’ve encountered so far. We have carefully reviewed all reported bugs and are committed to fixing them as soon as possible. Right now, we are working tirelessly to resolve those bugs and optimize content to ensure a smoother experience for our players. We will make sure to test all bug fixes and adjustments before rolling out the next patch.

Now, let’s take a look at the details of this upcoming patch:

Bug Fixes:
1、Fixed the issue where the Demon interface could not be turned off.
2、Fixed tips not fully displaying under accessories.
3、Resolved issues with fullscreen mode not working properly.
4、Fixed a problem where null items could drop at the end of a stage.
5、Improved the fidelity of the Beggar’s chest texture.

Gameplay Improvements:

1、Increased the influence of luck on the roulette wheel.
2、Adjusted the reforge process so that the armor set affects the stat weight.
3、The roulette now has a chance to drop two accessories instead of one.
4、Reduced the price of the Midas’ skill cost.
5、WASD keys can now be used as an alternative to arrow keys for UI navigation.
6、Health bars are now hidden when the character is at full health.

These fixes and improvements are based on the valuable feedback we recently received and hope these changes will meet your expectations! 

We are continuing to work hard on more updates in the future as we listed below, and our goal is to provide a smoother, more enjoyable experience for all players.

Future Update Plans:

● Adjustments to the Banana Tree (meta-progression system).
● Difficulty and monster stat balancing.
● Adjustments to boss invincibility and health lockout.
● Behavior logic adjustments for the "Grilled Squid" monster.
● Allowing players to retry boss battles after death.
● Weapon stat reevaluations.
● Adjustments to NPC interactions regarding negative stats.

We expect to complete these updates by December 17th US/December 18th CST (UTC+8).

The plans listed above specifically address the core issues recently reported by players. At the same time, we will continue to expand and optimize the game’s content and playability. A new roadmap outlining our detailed future updates will also be released in the next week.

We sincerely thank all of our community for your enthusiastic feedback! We will continue to listen closely to your feedback and respond quickly, conducting thorough testing and optimization to improve the overall experience, and will do our best to meet the expectations, delivering a game you enjoy and love!

notes.title: "Bronana" Is Out Now for $4.49 including a 10% Launch Discount!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328248/17e2b961f6100163b0e53250126cbc7ad2c8221c.jpg
Hello, everyone!

After a long journey of development, Bronana is finally here! 

Bronana is available now with a 10% launch discount, so get it now for just $4.49! Gambler Banana, Axecutioner Banana, and many other unique Banana Warriors are ready for action! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2492330/_/

[Thank You All]

We are immensely grateful for the support and love from all of our players.

It’s been over a year since our Steam store page went live, and thanks to your feedback, we’ve been motivated to continue improving and refining the game.

Through numerous updates and patches, Bronana has grown into the game it is today. This passion project of ours is finally ready for you to play! The development journey has always been an enjoyable one for us, and we hope it brings you joy as well—giving you a fun and engaging way to spend dozens of hours.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328248/0241d7ef2ea435145f10d8f1730c8ddbf74811fe.gif

[New Content]

The Bronana 1.0 version arrives with countless bug fixes as well as a massive expansion of content. We’ve expanded the content to approximately four times based on the Prologue version, with a robust selection of powerful builds to explore! 

In the 1.0 version, you’ll experience:

● 20+ Characters: Featuring diverse class traits like health, armor, evasion, poison, and coin-focused abilities, offering an incredibly rich variety of playstyles.
● 35+ Weapons and 240+ Accessories: Progress through challenging stages, unlocking increasingly powerful weapons until you evolve into the ultimate Banana Warlord.
● Brand-New NPC Interactions and Feedback: A stronger focus on gambling and randomness for a thrilling experience.
● 12+ Hilariously Quirky Bosses: Each boss comes with custom entrance and skill lines packed with joyful memes that will leave you laughing out loud.
● A New Meta-Progression System: Enhance characters outside of runs and customize enemy difficulty for a gradual challenge—start easy and ramp up the intensity!

You can choose Midas Banana which deals damage by picking up coins, become a long-range sharpshooter like Archer Banana, or go all-in for counter-damage style, tanking hits to strike back with force. There are countless builds and strategies waiting to be tested!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328248/b8c0f42e78e378fab476f659e23c9f24430883de.gif

[Future Plans]

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm! After the launch of the 1.0 version, we will continue updating the game with new content including new classes, bosses, maps, mechanics, and more.
We will also release a roadmap for future updates, so stay tuned! 
Please also join our community, where we welcome your feedback and suggestions to shape a better “Bronana” in the future!

notes.title: v0.1.1026
notes.content:
1. Completely redesigned the Blacksmith NPC.
2. Completely redesigned the Roulette Joker NPC.
3. Completely redesigned the Bounty Cowboy NPC.
4. Added a bullet hell phase to the boss fight.
5. Removed some of the existing minions.
6. Added new special minions:
    Red Potato Mole: While underground, it continuously shoots stone bullets at you and is very resilient. You need to get close to it, pull it out of the ground, and kill it.
    Cotton Candy: Periodically picks up coins from the ground. When it collects enough coins, it starts moving slower and killing it will yield more rewards.
    Corn Fire Sprout: The front side of the corn cob is very tough, while the back side is soft.
    Sardine Can: Roams around the area, emitting a foul odor that decreases the banana's attack speed and movement speed. Effects can stack.
    Popcorn Bumper Car: Charges towards the area where the banana is located after charging up.
French Fry Man: Constantly accelerates towards the banana.
7. Introduced powerful accessories that synergize with the Bounty Cowboy.
8. Modified the logic of the black hole, causing it to spawn near the banana instead of randomly across the entire map.
9. Adjusted the monster configurations for various difficulty levels to match the addition and removal of minions.
10. Lowered the unlock difficulty for some items.
11. Conducted performance optimizations to improve overall game performance.
12. Optimized and replaced some special effects.
13. Replaced the scene graphics to make them more visually appealing.
14. Added walking smoke for the characters.
15. Added fog effects to the environment.
16. Modified the damage bonuses of some equipment sets.
17. Resolved issues related to duplicate item acquisition and selling.
18. Implemented different clear markers for each character's progress.
